"''Oh, nothing serious, just a small malfunction.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, right before a starfighter malfunction renders the former unconscious|}} The '''defense of Cato Neimoidia''', also known as the '''invasion of Cato Neimoidia''' or the '''Battle of Cato Neimoidia''', was a battle fought during the later stages of the [[Clone Wars]] when the [[planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia]], which housed the headquarters of the [[Trade Federation]], was invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. That prompted the [[Galactic Republic]] to launch a defense of the planet, which it had [[Conquest of Cato Neimoidia|assumed]] control of previously. [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]] took part in this battle, but they were recalled to [[Coruscant]] following the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing]] of a [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] [[hangar]]. ==The battle== In [[19 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attacked the [[planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia]], which they had previously [[Conquest of Cato Neimoidia|lost]] to the [[Galactic Republic]].{{BuildR2Cite|44|Droid Directory}} The Republic dispatched [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and the elite [[501st Legion]] to defend the planet. [[Droid tri-fighter]]s played an important role in the fighting after a group of them was deployed from a [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]]. After punching through Separatist [[warship]]s in [[orbit]], Skywalker and Tano led a [[squadron]] of [[Z-95 Headhunter]]s to the surface, followed closely by another squadron of Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT/i gunships]] ferrying [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex|CT-7567]] and [[clone jetpack trooper]]s, as smaller Republic [[cruiser]]s engaged Separatist [[Starship|vessels]] around them. After a dogfight in the [[atmosphere]] resulted in [[Anakin Skywalker's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|Skywalker's starfighter]] getting hit by [[Pistoeka sabotage droid]]s, his fighter was disabled and he lost consciousness. After Tano was alerted to Skywalker's status by [[R2-D2]], also onboard Skywalker's fighter, she mounted a daring rescue by first telling R2 to crash land in a nearby [[mountain]] plain, and then jumped from [[Ahsoka Tano's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|her starfighter]] to his and was able to rescue him, just as his [[starfighter]] went over the cliff and was destroyed, but not before R2 also escaped. As Skywalker regained consciousness and became aware of what transpired, he received a transmission from [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]] who informed Skywalker and Tano that the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] had been [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombed]], and that they were being recalled to aid in the investigation. Afterwards Skywalker contacted [[Captain]] Rex for a pickup, as the battle continued. ==Aftermath== Even though the battle had begun to swing in the Republic's favor before Skywalker and Tano were called away,{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}} the Separatists ultimately won the battle at Cato Neimoidia, and their tri-fighters had again proven their worth in combat. Additionally, Cato Neimoidia would become embroiled in the war again, being the site of [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia|another battle]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]].{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} ==Behind the scenes== [[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2 44|''Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2'' 44]] stated that the defense of Cato Neimoidia ended in a Republic victory, but ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' later established it was a Separatist victory. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}} {{1st}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *{{LSWCite|78|The Gift of Giving}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|technology|buzz-droid|buzz droids}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *{{BuildFalconCite|31|Guide to the Galaxy}} *''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]'' {{Po}} *{{BuildR2Cite|44|Droid Directory}} *{{BuildR2Cite|85|Droid Directory}} *''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' *{{BuildXWingCite|67|Starfighter Aces}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|R2-D2}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic, Rebel, and Resistance Starfighters}} {{1stID|defense of Cato Neimoidia}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' {{1stID|Battle of Cato Neimoidia}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Droid Tanks and Vehicles, and Other Mechanicals}} {{1stID|invasion of Cato Neimoidia}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Clone Z-95 Headhunter Expansion Pack|cardname="Knack"}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonCloneWarsNav}} {{Interlang |es=Defensa de Cato Neimoidia |fr=Défense de Cato Neimoidia |ja=ケイト・ニモーディア防衛戦 |pl=Inwazja Separatystów na Cato Neimoidię }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Cato Neimoidia, Defense of}} [[Category:Battles of Cato Neimoidia]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]]
